title: RouterDecisionRecord
description: One record emitted per LLM request by the router hook (JSONL).

session_id.description: Agent run ID (x-agent-run-id header or fallback)

features.description: Feature set available at the active level (populated M2+)

risk_level.description: Risk level from the policy thresholds (#140)

data_class.description: Data classification of the request context (#181); post_call uses the class pre-call recorded, or sensitive if missing

data_class_rules.description: pre_call only: data_classes rule ids this request matched (#181); never the matched text

route.description: Route chosen by the admin routing table, or 'block' (#140)

assessed_risk_level.description: post_call only: level from this phase's own policy assessment

pre_call_risk_level.description: post_call only: level pre-call recorded; null if missing (post-call then assumes elevated). risk_level is the higher of the two.

action.description: Legacy action label derived from the route

tool_context.description: Parsed tool call and tool result counts from the request messages
